response.original_title: Gaping Gill: A Hundred Years of Exploration
response.overview: A  film made in 1995 to celebrate the 100 year anniversary of Frenchman Eduard Martel's first descent of Gaping Gill in Yorkshire. Members of the Bradford Pothole Club aquire period costume to re-enact the event at their annual winch meet.
response.title: Gaping Gill: A Hundred Years of Exploration
